title: Topological observables and domain wall tension from finite temperature chiral perturbation theory
summary: Within the framework of SU(2) chiral perturbation theory, we derive the general solution of the QCD $θ$-vacuum for an arbitrary vacuum phase, explicitly incorporating isospin-breaking effects from the light quark mass difference, and compute the temperature dependence of the topological susceptibility, higher-order cumulants, and the domain wall tension up to next-to-leading order.
